about_the_game:
Cyber-ART is a clicker game where you need to click on artworks! You will obtain a random artwork every 3 hours, allowing you to continuously expand your art collection!

The drop rates every 3 hours are as follows*:

  • Common: 70%

  • Frequent: 25%

  • Uncommon: 4.89%

  • Rare: 0.1%

  • Epic: 0.01%

  • Ultra-rare: 1 in 400,000

  • Legendary: 1 in 10,000,000

Features: First, it offers the joy of collecting Cyber artworks for free. Second, it is a clicker game. With a simple program that consumes little resources, you can use it with confidence. Rely on your efforts and luck to acquire super collectible artworks. There is also a community full of the ART theme. Everyone is welcome to submit art designs! Come and join us!
